protocol.primary_population: 40 non-random held-out players; 10 random controllers are a separate negative control.
protocol.selection: One player per independent test group, balanced across five controller families and known/unseen compositions. First five games form support; earliest subsequent new-roster game with ten labelled decisions is fixed before prediction.
protocol.controls: Correct player history; common prior; another player from the same family and composition scenario. Donor is fixed across history lengths, matched by effective history length and public team-type frequencies.
protocol.carry: Only weighted Z is inherited. Fresh C/X, encoder memory, previous action and change history. Identical initial candidate pools and RNG state across query conditions.
protocol.prediction: Predict, obtain observed resolution, update. Model weights remain fixed. Family, true action lists and controller distributions are evaluation-only.
protocol.action_metrics: Move identity or switch destination, with Tera variants marginalized. Expected NLL and KL use the logged controller distribution; TV includes predicted actions absent from true support. Submitted-action NLL and Top-1 are also reported.
protocol.profiles: Situation-conditioned behavior probabilities from current_action_tendencies. Score switch/setup/recovery/Tera when both that behavior and an alternative are legally available in an ordinary decision. Standardized dossier opportunity subsets are also reported.
protocol.profile_metric: Per-player MAE for each behavior, then equal average over available behaviors and players. Full query decisions are retained for action metrics.
protocol.missing: Missing teacher distributions are omitted only from distribution scores. Invalid model predictions receive NLL -log(1e-12), TV=1, profile error=1 and zero Top-1; failures remain in denominators.
protocol.uncertainty: Equal-player means and paired bootstrap confidence intervals, 2000 player resamples. Fixed donor assignment. Primary comparison is H=5 correct versus each control; all H=0/1/3/5 results are retained.
